about: WHAT THE SWARM IS TO BE EQUIVALENT ON. Parity is equivalence with the larger model on a body of work, and which work is chosen (the page, under the models; or "equivalence" in src/config.json). Each entry names the kinds of question (training/tasks.mjs) that make it up. More than one can be chosen: a pass then asks all of their kinds. A choice takes effect when the next pass begins. benchmarks: how the swarm is EVALUATED on it, apart from training (training/evaluate.mjs, the page's Evaluate the swarm): standard tasks of EleutherAI's lm-evaluation-harness, each asked of the larger model and of the swarm, and compared answer by answer. task: the harness's name for it; metric and filter: the score the harness reports for it, and the answers that score is taken from; compare: what makes two answers equivalent (answer: the same answer, as the harness extracts it; verdict: the same pass or fail on the task's own tests; instructions: the same instructions followed and broken). Training never asks a benchmark's question.
